title: Controlled local R&D work-packet executor
hypothesis: A tiny read-only Git subprocess allowlist, bound to a hashed RND-0020 work packet and execution plan, can produce deterministic validation evidence without granting arbitrary command, candidate-code, network, Git mutation, merge, promotion or trading authority.
inputs: RND-0020 work packet with human-only authority and explicit validation labels
Locally derived hashed execution plan using only internally defined action IDs
result: PASS on exact tested head 42a4a3a0310bb7ccaa1c23a7f98dd1a25f6872f6: 41 focused orchestration tests passed; 106 M006f regression tests passed; RND_WORKSPACE_AUDIT passed with 21 tasks, 20 experiments, broker writes false, protected paths modified false, promotion authority human-only; git diff --check was clean. Executor authority is restricted to commit-to-commit diff-check and scope-check; candidate code, worktree status, network, arbitrary subprocess, merge and promotion authority remain excluded.
